items.text: For its bank and credit union advisors (FID) division, Raymond James reports $166 million in average assets under management per advisor across 940 advisors at 160 financial institutions — an assets-under-management (not AUA) per-advisor measure limited to that division.
items.quote: $166 million in average assets under management per advisor

cells.reason: The passages directly bear on comparability: the firm explicitly notes client asset definitions may be inconsistent across companies, excludes RCS advisors from its advisor count while their assets remain in AUA, and reports distinct per-advisor asset measures (AUA vs AUM for a division), all of which affect the validity of a side-by-side client-assets-per-advisor comparison.
